pages.title: Find a Seed
pages.text: Look for Ender Lily Endstone in newly generated End terrain. Ore placement attempts are between Y=0 and Y=60. Breaking the ore yields an Ender Lily Seed.
If you have a block of Ender Lily Endstone, you can also convert it into a seed.

pages.title: Growing Ender Lilies
pages.text: Plant the seed on End Stone or Ender Core. Ender Core speeds growth. The plant grows through eight stages.$(br2)Right-click a ripe plant to take one Ender Pearl and restart growth. Avoid touching ripe plants because they deal damage.

pages.title: Harvest and Replant
pages.text: Break a fully grown lily or remove its support to recover the seed and one Ender Pearl. An immature plant drops its seed.$(br2)The later growth stages are exposed as separate blocks in Creative.
